company.name: n8n
company.shortDescription: N8n is a workflow automation tool that integrates AI capabilities with business process automation.
company.description: N8n provides a flexible AI workflow automation platform that supports building and integrating multi-step AI agents and applications. The tool is designed for technical teams, offering options for drag-and-drop building or code-based customization. N8n offers self-hosting capability, allowing users to deploy on-premise, or use a hosted cloud-based version with over 500 integrations.

productsAndServices.description: A visual workflow automation platform for connecting applications, transforming data, and automating business processes with low-code tools and custom JavaScript or Python.
